items.name: Almonty Rwanda strategic tungsten partnership
items.claim: Almonty Industries entered a binding agreement with the Government of Rwanda giving the GOR a 25% interest in Almonty Rwanda Pty Ltd, in exchange for the GOR's contribution of the Shyorongi tungsten exploration concession and a mineral processing license, with Almonty holding the remaining 75%.
items.source_excerpt: it has entered into a binding agreement with the Government of Rwanda (the “ GOR ”) under which the GOR will receive a 25% interest in Almonty Rwanda Pty Ltd (“ Almonty Rwanda ”) in exchange for the contribution of the Shyorongi tungsten exploration concession and a mineral processing license, with Almonty holding the remaining 75%.

notes: Stored 6-K (0001493152-26-042480, filed 2026-09-14) discloses the Rwanda joint venture in full. It names no dollar backlog or RPO figure -- the agreement is a concession/equity structure, not a priced contract.
